branches.B: per-channel endpoint-matched slerp of the upperarm_l / lowerarm_l basis between Action context_last and target_first, t = (f - f0) / 29, interior only
branches.C: MotionBricks primary sample, left-arm channels projected on the interior only

case_rule.A: G0-G7 pass AND QA1-QA5 pass (visible quality improvement vs BOTH the no-op A and the slerp B without materially worse source fidelity)
case_rule.B: authentic model and a safe separate Blender candidate are demonstrated (G0-G7 pass) but any A quality criterion (QA1-QA5) fails
case_rule.C: the real model ran but a timing (G2), mapping (G1), Action (G4) or hard-constraint (G5) gate fails, or the representation cannot be projected safely
case_rule.D: invalid evidence or predeclared control-integrity failure: a mapping/runtime/adapter negative control does not fail closed, the primary sample is not the real pinned model (mock/substitution/provenance mismatch), or an instrument changed after this declaration
case_rule.DATA_BLOCKED: a prerequisite (model bytes/licence/runtime, authentic S1 baseline/lineage, Blender, native-time alignment) is missing before any primary evidence
case_rule.precedence: DATA_BLOCKED > D > C > B > A; S3 (secondary) never changes the S1 CASE

gates.G1: mapping controls pass: real-frame left-arm round trip <= 1e-5 (quaternion component), posed-control primary direction residual <= 0.05 deg, no-mirroring ok, left-right and parent-child behave as declared, mirrored axis refused
gates.G2: timing: allowed token mask exactly {9}; pred_num_tokens == 9; valid samples == 30; endpoint-corrected LeftArm/LeftForeArm locals at sample 0 / 29 equal the last context / first target pose within 2e-3 rad
gates.G3: real inference provenance: ONNX bytes = LFS OID 856419dc..., official MotionBricksSOMAEngine TensorRT plan, raw tensors saved
gates.G4: candidate is a separate .blend + separately named Action; fresh-process readback: 1 Action, 32 CONSTANT F-curves keyed 1..N, 30 fps, scene 1..N; changed keys only upperarm_l/lowerarm_l on interior frames; every non-left-arm bone world point and the object matrix bit-equal on every integer frame and subframe; left arm bit-equal outside the interior; baseline/lineage files unchanged
gates.G5: hard pin: the W126V pin domain (Action frames of source 210-218 for S1) is bit-equal; C composed onto the W126V-accepted .blend keeps every pin-frame residual equal to the W126V residual and <= 1e-6 m
gates.G6: negative controls fail closed (runtime: missing ONNX, wrong bytes, LFS pointer, skeleton missing joint; adapter: mirrored axis, missing BaseRig bone, protected overlap, non-30-sample window, out-of-domain channel/frame build)
gates.G7: native-rate synchronized A/B/C video: N_action frames written and decoded at 30.000 fps

pre_declaration_observations: A/B-only plumbing dry run on a scratch copy (no model output observed): on S1 the world-space wrist steps around Action 171-177 (300-400 mm) are partly carried by the SHOULDER itself (154-244 mm/frame from the source-derived object/spine_01 tracks, out of the edit domain); in the clavicle_l frame the largest A arm-channel jump is 170->171 (220 mm, inside the frozen context, not editable) followed by 93-203 mm steps at 171-178. A world-space flick criterion would therefore not isolate the edit; QA1/QA2 use arm-local wrist kinematics. The frozen window is NOT changed.

quality_criteria.QA1: C has 0 ARM-LOCAL wrist reversal flicks (wrist in the clavicle_l frame, i.e. attributable to the edited channels) in steps context_last->+1 .. target_first-1->target_first (consecutive steps both > 20 mm with negative dot)
quality_criteria.QA2: C ARM-LOCAL boundary C0 entry/exit wrist steps each <= 2 x B's corresponding step + 10 mm
quality_criteria.QA3: C introduces no near-straight (> 175 deg) interior frame, no bend-direction flip and no frame bending against the A hinge reference
quality_criteria.QA4: source fidelity: C mean interior wrist deviation from A <= 1.25 x B's + 25 mm
quality_criteria.QA5: blinded agent visual review: C judged most natural (V2), C not named for a visible flick (V1) or wrong elbow (V3), and C not ranked least source-faithful (V4)

secondary: S3 runs with the identical frozen configuration only after the S1 primary completes; transfer check only
stop_conditions: G1 mapping control failure -> STOP before S1 inference (representation incompatible)
token count != 9 or valid != 30 -> no retiming, report C
projection would touch any non-left-arm channel or frame outside the interior -> refuse (C)
no tuning: no other window, seed, token count, precision, model or post-processing after seeing output
time_rule: 9 allowed tokens -> 36 raw frames; the official engine drops 3 boundary frames per end and endpoint-corrects, so valid sample k = SOURCE context_last + k (k = 0..29); sample 0 = last context pose, sample 29 = first target pose; only the 28 interior samples are written; no retiming, no resampling
visual_protocol: panels X/Y/Z = random permutation of A/B/C drawn at run time and sealed in blind_key.json; the agent writes its answers to the blinded sheets/video BEFORE reading the key; the review is AGENT-ONLY (no human/animator)

visual_questions.V1: Which panel(s) show a visible unnatural one-frame flick/teleport/reversal of the left arm (around Action 171-175)?
visual_questions.V2: Which panel's left-arm motion through the interior looks most natural and temporally coherent at native rate?
visual_questions.V3: Which panel(s) show an anatomically wrong elbow (hyperextension, flip) or limb-length artefact?
visual_questions.V4: Rank the panels by agreement with the source video's visible left-arm pose and timing (rack -> press); which is least faithful?
visual_questions.V5: Is any boundary discontinuity visible at 171/172 or 199/200 in any panel?
